counterfactual: SUBTRACTIVE on L5's observed fills. Assumes the surviving fills still happen, which is false in detail -- no historical book exists here. Read as 'the economics of the trades we would have kept'.
fees: usdcSize is fee-inclusive, so trading_pnl_after_fees is already net of the fee actually paid; fee_usd is reported separately as usdcSize - price*size.
incentives: NOT included anywhere. L5's rebates/rewards are account-level and are never attributed to a market.
